about.label: About me
about.heading: A little about me.
paragraphs: I’m a practical problem solver who enjoys making complicated things easier to understand and manage. I’m curious about why things go wrong and how they affect the people dealing with them. My strengths are asking clear questions, breaking a challenge into manageable pieces, and figuring out which change would help the most. I care about solutions that make everyday life a little easier.
